headword: {焦点|しょうてん}を{絞|しぼ}る
gloss: to focus; to narrow down the focus

definitions.gloss: to focus; to narrow down the focus; to zero in on
definitions.explanation: To concentrate attention or discussion on a specific point or topic, narrowing from a broader scope. Used in discussions, research, investigations, and presentations.

examples.japanese: ⟦{議論|ぎろん}→議論：02650_giron⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{焦点|しょうてん}を{絞|しぼ}る。
examples.english: To narrow down the focus of the discussion.

examples.japanese: ⟦{調査|ちょうさ}→調査：03489_chousa⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{焦点|しょうてん}を{絞|しぼ}って⟦{効率|こうりつ}→効率：11794_kouritsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{上|あ}げた→上げる：02443_ageru⟧。
examples.english: We improved efficiency by narrowing the focus of the investigation.

examples.japanese: ⟦テーマ→テーマ：17684_teema⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{広|ひろ}すぎる⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦もう→もう：00602_mou⟧⟦{少|すこ}し→少し：00596_sukoshi⟧{焦点|しょうてん}を{絞|しぼ}った⟦ほうがいい→ほうがいい：10078_hougaii⟧でしょう。
examples.english: The topic is too broad, so it would be better to narrow the focus a bit more.

notes:
USAGE:
Common in academic, business, and journalistic contexts. The metaphor comes from optics — adjusting a lens to bring a subject into sharp focus.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{議論|ぎろん}→議論：02650_giron⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{焦点|しょうてん}を{絞|しぼ}る (to focus the discussion)
- ⟦{調査|ちょうさ}→調査：03489_chousa⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{焦点|しょうてん}を{絞|しぼ}る (to narrow the investigation)
- {焦点|しょうてん}を{絞|しぼ}って⟦{取|と}り{組|く}む→取り組む：04225_torikumu⟧ (to work on something with a focused approach)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{焦点|しょうてん}→焦点：13413_shouten⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{当|あ}てる→当てる：01864_ateru⟧: to focus on — emphasizes directing attention, while ⟦{絞|しぼ}る→絞る：03926_shiboru⟧ emphasizes narrowing from a broader scope
